name: RAWG
tagline: Video game database API for games, platforms, genres, and reviews
description: RAWG provides a large video game database API with endpoints for games, platforms, genres, tags, stores, developers, publishers, and user content. Developers can search and filter games, retrieve screenshots and trailers, and access metadata such as release dates, ratings, and platforms. Authentication is via a free API key obtained through self-serve signup.

auth.details: API key via query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY; free self-serve signup at rawg.io

rate_limits: not published beyond free tier monthly quota
use_cases: search games by name or keyword
get game details including platforms and ratings
list games by platform or genre
